name: Takamiya Kaname
source:
A young man who moved from Abashiri, Hokkaido. He has a gentle demeanor and speaks to animals and children using honorifics. While indifferent to others, once he trusts someone, he becomes abnormally obsessed. He harbors a strong longing for the word “friend,” and his devotion borders on worship.

[Translated from in-game profile]
